## Description

Programme: MDV-P1-E12 · UX programme: safe, cohesive clinic workspace (from the Nov 2026 product UX audit). Track D (design rules and UI component setup), wave D3. This is audit backlog UX-34 of the Nov 2026 product UX audit (an audit id, not an MDV key).

Persona and route: /settings (all groups), walk-in success, /organisation · owner, practice admin, receptionist.
Findings and reviewers: F-37, F-38, F-39, F-40, F-43 · reviewers A-22, A-25, A-26, C-17. (F-41 has no ticket: see the epic. F-46 is in the Azure redeploy ticket.)
Rationale: Small things that make the product look unsure of itself: a success message that names the wrong column, a status that says booking is paused while booking works, a switch that changes everyone's board mid-day with no warning, a page that calls an endpoint answering 404, and two tab rows in two styles.
Proposed UX behaviour: Five fixes, each its own small change. (1) Walk-in success names the column the card is really in (Ready for doctor when nurse intake is off). (2) Settings → Terms: the status line matches what the server enforces; if the Azure check shows booking is not paused, the line is corrected, and if it should be paused, that is raised as a defect against the terms gate. (3) Switching nurse intake on or off asks to confirm and says what happens to patients now with the nurse. (4) /organisation for an approved clinic shows Approved with the date, or is hidden, and no longer calls an endpoint that answers 404. (5) Settings uses a left sub-navigation at 1024 px and wider in place of the second tab row; the five groups and the ?tab= addresses stay.
Prototype and blueprint reference: docs/product-ux-audit/08-design-system-blueprint.md section 3 (Settings).
Components and tokens affected: PageMessage, the existing Dialog, SegmentedControl or a nav list for settings. i18n keys.
Front end and back end split: Front end; (2) may turn out to be a back-end defect.
Prerequisites and blocked by: Blocked by the page components ticket. Timing: after the first pilot weeks, or before the first staff training session if the founder moves it there; never between training and the first two pilot weeks (arbitration ruling 6). Fixes 1, 3 and 4 are not renames and may land at any time.
Clinical sign-off: Not required.
Effort and regression risk: S each · Low.
Deliberately NOT in this ticket: (1) Regrouping settings panels. (2) Synthetic names on Azure (the redeploy ticket).

## Acceptance criteria

- [ ] **AC1.** Given nurse intake off, when a walk-in is checked in, then the success message names Ready for doctor
- [ ] **AC2.** Given Settings → Terms, when booking is allowed, then the status does not say booking is paused; when it is paused, then booking is refused by the server
- [ ] **AC3.** Given patients with the nurse, when the owner switches nurse intake off, then a dialog says how many are with the nurse and what happens to them, and nothing changes until confirmed
- [ ] **AC4.** Given an approved clinic, when /organisation opens, then no request answers 404 and the page says Approved or is not in the menu
- [ ] **AC5.** Given 1024 px and wider, when Settings opens, then a left sub-navigation replaces the second tab row and each ?tab= address opens the same panel as before
- [ ] **AC6.** Given English and Arabic, when axe runs on each changed screen, then there is no violation
